latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of bearing-search skill:

- Supports searching for bearing model specifications (dimensions, type, seal, etc.).
- Allows lookup and comparison of bearing brands and product lines.
- Decodes and explains bearing model code structures and suffixes.
- Provides application-based bearing selection advice.
- Uses structured databases for models and brands.
- Includes usage examples and reference documentation for codes and brands.
